{{Quote|Did you sell my guests the mushroom?''"<br />"''Yes, of course. Nothing but the best&mdash;''"<br />"''And why then has it been cut with Xyathone?''"<br />"''What? I did not know, I swear&mdash;|Trillot interrogates Guntar|<ref name="TCD" />}}
'''Xyathone''' was a chemical with a distinct taste and smell that could be used to dilute [[Spice/Legends|narcotic]] [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]]. This occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] in the [[X'Ting]] [[Crime lord/Legends|gangster]] [[Trillot]]'s [[Trillot's facility|facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus]]. The usage of Xyathone greatly displeased Trillot as it reduced the potency and quality of the drug. Furious with the [[Zeetsa]] [[Guntar]], who had sold the contaminated drugs to the facility's [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] customers, Trillot provided recompense to the Chadra-Fan while severely punishing Guntar.

==Description==
{{Quote|You should have smelled it. Tasted it in the mixing.|Trillot challenges Guntar's claimed innocence.|<ref name="TCD" />}}
Xyathone was a chemical with a distinct smell and taste. It could be incorporated with other substances, such as certain [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]] used as a [[Spice/Legends|drug]].<ref name="TCD" />

==History==
{{Quote|Do you say that that insignificant nose and tongue of yours aren't up to the task?''"<br />"''I&hellip; I suppose&hellip;''"<br />"''You know how I loathe inefficiency. See that the offending organs are removed.|Trillot condemns Guntar's capabilities and punishes him.|<ref name="TCD" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'' to c. [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[X'Ting]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Gang leader]] [[Trillot]] was escorting his younger [[Trillot's brood|broodmate]] [[Fizzik]] through his [[Trillot's facility|hidden facility]] on the [[Plant/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. As the brothers made their way through the facility, Trillot detected the scent of Xyathone in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], displeasing the criminal leader. The group proceeded to an alcove where a pair [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] were imbibing upon some mushrooms from a [[Temperature/Legends|boiling]] [[Flask/Legends|flask]]. The mushrooms had been contaminated with Xyathone, reducing the potency and quality of the drug.<ref name="TCD" />

Trillot summoned [[Guntar]], a [[Zeetsa]] who had sold the Chadra-Fan guests the mushrooms. Trillot briefly interrogated Guntar, challenging the Zeetsa's claims that the mushrooms were of the highest quality. When Guntar proclaimed<ref name="TCD" /> his<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|376|Guntar}}</ref> innocence, the gangster noted that the Zeetsa should have detected the contaminant in either the smell or the taste of the product. As Guntar's [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and [[Mouth/Legends|tongue]] had proven incapable of ensuring quality mushrooms, Trillot ordered his guards to remove the offending organs to Guntar's horror. To provide recompense to the Chadra-Fan, Trillot ordered additional guards to provide them mushrooms from his personal store.<ref name="TCD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xyathone first appeared in ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'', a [[2004]] novel written by [[Steven Barnes]] as part of the [[Clone Wars multimedia project]].<ref name="TCD" /> The scene featuring xyathone was cut from the abridged [[The Cestus Deception (abridged audiobook)|audiobook]], released in [[2007]] and performed by [[Jonathan Davis]]. The audiobook notes Fizzik's intent to provide information to Trillot upon entry to the facility, before skipping this scene to continue with the next chapter.<ref name="TCDaudio">[[The Cestus Deception (abridged audiobook)|''The Cestus Deception'' abridged audiobook]]</ref>
